articles.title: COMMERCIAL USE OF PERSONAL ACCOUNTS
body: Use permissions: GitHub's Terms of Service explicitly allow a free personal account to execute projects with commercial purposes. There is no penalty or mandatory charge for operating a commercial site or private repository under this modality.

Ownership and independence: the project and source code are hosted under the client's account. If, in the future, the project requires scaling to a corporate scheme, the account or repository can be migrated without service interruption to a GitHub Organization.

articles.title: GITHUB PAGES HOSTING: CONDITIONS
body: GitHub Pages is a service designed to serve static web pages (HTML, CSS, JavaScript and images). Its use for commercial websites is subject to the following guidelines:
list: Accepted sites: informational corporate sites, professional portfolios, landing pages, digital catalogs and brand blogs.

Commercial restrictions (prohibited use): GitHub Pages is not designed to function as a massive e-commerce platform (with complex transactional payment gateways managed on the same server), nor to resell hosting services or host applications as a software-as-a-service (SaaS).

articles.title: TECHNICAL LIMITS OF FREE SERVICE
body: Use of the service within GitHub's free plan includes the following maximum capabilities per repository and published site:
list: Bandwidth (traffic): 100 GB per month — enough for thousands of monthly site visits in an optimized site.
Published site size: maximum 1 GB — applies to the files deployed for the website.
Repository size: maximum 1 GB (recommended) — limit of source code stored in GitHub.
Compilations (builds): maximum 10 deployments per hour — applies to publishing or updating site content.
CI/CD minutes (Actions): 2,000 minutes per month — allocated time to automate updates or tests.
articles.note: Note on limits: if a site repeatedly exceeds the bandwidth limit (100 GB/month) or storage, GitHub does not immediately apply a surprise charge, but may temporarily suspend GitHub Pages service or send a notification to optimize content or migrate to a dedicated server.

articles.title: RESPONSIBILITIES AND RECOMMENDATIONS
body: To ensure continuity and proper functioning of the published site, the following points are recommended:
list: Custom domain: to give an appropriate commercial profile, linking a custom domain (example: www.yourbusiness.com) is recommended. DNS record configuration and SSL certificate issuance incur no additional cost on GitHub.

Content backup: very high-resolution images or large files (such as videos or bulky PDFs) should be hosted on external storage services (such as Google Drive, AWS S3 or Cloudinary) to not saturate GitHub Pages limits.
Loss or modification of access: the client is solely responsible for maintaining the security and credentials of their GitHub account, including email access and two-factor authentication (2FA).
